title: Amphenol Beats Second-Quarter Forecasts as AI Demand Fuels Growth and Outlook Improves
excerpt: Amphenol Corporation (NYSE:APH) reported stronger-than-expected second-quarter results and issued an upbeat third-quarter outlook, driven by robust demand fo...
content_html:
Amphenol Corporation (NYSE:APH) reported stronger-than-expected second-quarter results and issued an upbeat third-quarter outlook, driven by robust demand for AI-related data communications products and contributions from recent acquisitions. The company's shares rose around 7% in premarket trading following the announcement.

The connector manufacturer posted adjusted earnings of $1.35 per share, comfortably ahead of Wall Street's consensus estimate of $1.16.

Revenue increased to $8.76 billion from $5.65 billion a year earlier, surpassing analysts' expectations of $8.19 billion. Organic sales grew 30% during the quarter, while orders reached a record $10.7 billion, resulting in a book-to-bill ratio of 1.23.

AI Infrastructure Continues to Drive Growth

Amphenol said exceptional demand for its IT datacom products continued to support strong performance as investment in artificial intelligence infrastructure accelerated.

Chairman and Chief Executive Officer R. Adam Norwitt highlighted the company's broad-based momentum across multiple end markets, led by outstanding organic growth within its IT datacom business.

Adjusted operating margin expanded to 29.8%, supported in part by an $80 million net benefit related to the recovery of IEEPA tariffs.

Third-Quarter Guidance Exceeds Expectations

Looking ahead, Amphenol forecast adjusted third-quarter earnings of between $1.40 and $1.42 per share on revenue of $9.3 billion to $9.4 billion.

Both forecasts came in comfortably above Wall Street expectations of adjusted earnings of $1.28 per share and revenue of $8.77 billion.

The company's guidance does not include any additional benefit from future tariff recoveries.

Acquisition Outlook Raised

Amphenol also improved its outlook for the recently acquired CommScope connectivity and cable solutions business.

The company now expects the acquisition to contribute approximately $4.6 billion in revenue during 2026 and increase adjusted diluted earnings per share by $0.30, compared with its previous forecast of $4.1 billion in revenue and $0.15 of earnings accretion.

During the quarter, Amphenol further expanded its portfolio by completing the acquisitions of El.Com and Wilder Technologies.

content_html_zh:
安费诺公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：APH）报告了强于预期的第二季度业绩，并发布了乐观的第三季度前景，这得益于对人工智能相关数据通信产品的强劲需求以及最近收购的贡献。 消息公布后，该公司股价在盘前交易中上涨约 7%。

这家连接器制造商公布的调整后每股收益为 1.35 美元，远远高于华尔街普遍预期的 1.16 美元。

收入从上年同期的 56.5 亿美元增至 87.6 亿美元，超过分析师 81.9 亿美元的预期。 本季度有机销售额增长 30%，订单达到创纪录的 107 亿美元，订单出货比达到 1.23。

人工智能基础设施继续推动增长

安费诺表示，随着人工智能基础设施投资的加速，对其 IT 数据通信产品的巨大需求继续支持其强劲的业绩。

董事长兼首席执行官 R. Adam Norwitt 强调了该公司在多个终端市场的广泛势头，这得益于其 IT 数据通信业务的出色有机增长。

调整后的营业利润率扩大至 29.8%，部分原因是与 IEEPA 关税恢复相关的 8000 万美元净利润。

第三季度指导超出预期

展望未来，安费诺预计第三季度调整后每股收益为 1.40 美元至 1.42 美元，营收为 93 亿美元至 94 亿美元。

这两项预测均远高于华尔街预期的调整后每股收益 1.28 美元和营收 87.7 亿美元。

该公司的指导不包括未来关税回收带来的任何额外好处。

上调收购前景

安费诺还改善了最近收购的康普连接和电缆解决方案业务的前景。

该公司目前预计，此次收购将在 2026 年贡献约 46 亿美元的收入，并使调整后的稀释每股收益增加 0.30 美元，而此前的预测为 41 亿美元的收入和 0.15 美元的盈利增长。

本季度，安费诺通过完成对 El.Com 和 Wilder Technologies 的收购，进一步扩大了其产品组合。
